title: ControlPlaneMachineFile
description: SPEC §8.3, §4.5: `machine.json` in the bindings directory, the operator's choices for this machine, made once and kept beside the bindings. A key that is absent has not been decided.

telemetry.description: The operator's consent to telemetry for every Claude Code session on this machine, recorded by `ccp init --telemetry on|off`. `on`: init writes the user-level telemetry keys and installs the receiver and the product's board timer. `off`: init writes nothing outside the product and no longer mentions telemetry.
